Straight-on rooftop-level view, level horizon, no isometric perspective, no vanishing-point street.
Composition: shared full artboard, upper 48% quiet negative space, city occupies lower half, darkest and least detailed on upper/left behind HTML headline. Strongest restrained environmental detail near lower/right, without competing with a large OS window in the right half. Continuous horizontal silhouettes reach BOTH image edges; avoid a centered floating island or vignette.
No text, letters, symbols resembling text, labels, logos, signs, UI, watermarks, borders, panels, people, or large bright advertisements. This is one layer, not a full assembled scene or contact sheet.
Generate ONLY an opaque midnight sky background. Deep navy star field, very sparse tiny dim teal stars, layered wispy pixel clouds concentrated along upper right and lower edge, a small muted amber moon near upper-right quarter. Leave left/top broad and calm. NO buildings, rooftops, horizon architecture, props, ground, foreground. Sky fills every pixel, darkest behind left copy.
